title: Plugin protocol v1 error mapping
description: Normative mapping of existing Go SDK errors and references to operation-specific gRPC status contracts.

PluginServiceClient.streamFailure: raw gRPC status is returned to the caller

rpcFailureIncludes: secret larger than the client message limit

rules.callResponseCode: A non-empty CallResponse.code is an application-level rejection carried in a successful gRPC response; transport.Client.Call returns ErrCallRejected.
rules.context: The public unary Go client preserves caller cancellation and deadline as context.Canceled and context.DeadlineExceeded. Client.Stream returns its raw gRPC status without unary error classification.
rules.genericClientRpcError: For PluginService unary client operations, any other gRPC failure maps to ErrUnavailable; operation-specific raw gRPC statuses remain defined by their referenced contracts.
rules.grantRpcError: GrantClient does not expose broker status/details or secret bytes through errors; any failed or invalid redemption response maps to ErrGrantRejected.
rules.redaction: Errors and diagnostics must not include secret bytes, grant handles, cookie values, or source paths.
